rows: - 13 Nov, the t3-serve replay flake (issue #80 section A): run 43437239290 failed once in `recorded_r1` on three `t3-crawl` rows (`pullRequests.filterOptions-invalid-*`) that got no answer from the replay. Cause: the replay waited only `LOCAL_QUIET_MS` (120 ms) for the first answer to a request, which the chain behind t3-serve (t3-serve, rca-service, rca-exec) can exceed on a loaded runner. A request is always answered (a reply, an error or the close), so after a `Request` frame the replay now waits up to 3 s for the first thing the server sends, then applies the 120 ms quiet window as before. Integration: 65 `t3-serve` tests pass (360 s), no known-gaps change.
